mail.subject: Your estimate from LiveLayer: {interval} a year
mail.intro: Thanks for trying our calculator. Here is the number and the short explanation behind it.
mail.peakTitle: Sales that walk away from the queue
mail.peakText: At peak times, guests want to buy more than the bars can serve. The tills only show what was sold – not what guests wanted – so the loss is invisible in your own numbers. Much of it can be won back with volunteers, payment terminals and bars in the right places when the situations occur.
mail.vendText: Food driven home, and sales lost when a stall sells out. With a range up front, vendors get it right more often – which helps them and you.
mail.whyText: The estimate builds on comparable festivals. With your own sales figures, the range gets narrower and concrete.
mail.nextText: We're happy to do the real analysis on your own numbers – with the concrete situations, bar by bar, and what each recommendation is worth. Right now it's free for the first 4–5 partners.
